title: A counterexample to finitistic-dimension finiteness

result.label: A counterexample to finitistic-dimension finiteness
result.statement: Constructs a finite-dimensional complex algebra whose finite-dimensional modules have unbounded finite projective dimensions. This disproves the little finitistic-dimension conjecture.
